checks.name: Wall thickness
checks.detail: Nominal wall 0.08 mm is below ABS minimum (1.2 mm). Risk of short shots & high pressure drop.

checks.name: Draft angles
checks.detail: Stated draft 3° comfortably exceeds the 0.50° required. Mesh shows 100% of side-wall area below 0.50° draft (either mould half) — major rework needed.

checks.name: Ribs & bosses
checks.detail: Rib t/wall ratio 0.45 is in the recommended 0.4–0.5× band (Malloy §2.4.2).

checks.name: Undercuts / parting line
checks.detail: No undercuts declared. Straight-pull tool feasible — lowest tooling cost.

checks.name: Sink-mark risk
checks.detail: 4.8% of surface area shows moderate sink risk (local mass > 1.6× nominal wall). Likely at rib bases and boss roots — increase rib t/wall ratio or add cosmetic relief.

checks.name: Flow length (L/T)
checks.detail: No gate location set, so flow length has not been computed. Nothing is deducted for this — the check simply has not run. Of 12 candidate positions tried across the part's outer surface, the best is (-0.7, 0.4, 1.0), giving a worst-case L/T of 43 against the 180 limit for ABS. Press "Use best" to place it, or pick your own.

checks.name: Shrinkage & warpage
checks.detail: ABS is dimensionally stable (shrink 0.4–0.7%). Low warpage risk under normal conditions.

checks.name: Corner radii (advisory)
checks.detail: Literature guidelines: internal corners ≥ 1.00 mm (0.5× wall), external corners ≥ 3.00 mm (1.5× wall). Sharp internal corners concentrate stress and require EDM tooling. Sharp external corners impede flow. Verify in CAD before tooling.

checks.name: Surface finish compatibility
checks.detail: SPI A-2 (high polish #6 diamond) is achievable in ABS.

issues.title: Check the units
issues.detail: The largest dimension is 1.57 mm. No injection-moulded part is that small, so this file is almost certainly not in millimetres — and every threshold in this tool is. Analysing it as-is will fail the wall check on a part that is fine.

assumptions: Clamp force is the 30–45 MPa cavity pressure typical of a medium-flow material acting over 0.0 cm² of projected area. Specify a machine at least 10–20% above the top of that range.
Projected area is measured along the current pull axis. Change the pull direction and this changes with it.
